column1: # Magahi word gold set, written 2026-11-14 before any Magahi-specific rules. Format: word, broad pronunciation(s)
# separated by |, category, source. K = Wiktionary Magahi entry (lemma and romanisation from the kaikki.org
# extraction of English Wiktionary, https://kaikki.org/dictionary/Magahi/, CC BY-SA 4.0, evaluation only, fetched
# 2026-11-14); Kaithi-script lemmas are kept in Kaithi for 45 items (category kaithi), the rest are written in
# Devanagari. The pronunciation is converted from the Wiktionary romanisation and checked by hand (medial and final
# vowels, ā = aː, ai au = əi əu, ṛ = ɽ, ś ṣ ṇ = s s n). F = word attested in FLORES-200 mag_Deva (CC BY-SA 4.0,
# evaluation only); G = form given in a grammar description: Grierson, Linguistic Survey of India V.2 (1903, public
# domain), Magahi sketch; Verma 2003, "Magahi", in Cardona & Jain (eds.), The Indo-Aryan Languages; Aryani 1965,
# A Grammar of Magahi. F/G pronunciations hand-written from those grammars: no ʃ ʂ ɳ (Sanskrit loans written with
# श ष ण also accepted with the Hindi sounds), initial व in Sanskrit loans = b, ऐ औ and a vowel followed by इ उ = əi
# əu, final -ई/-इ/-य after a consonant with the inherent vowel = the diphthong əi (हलई hələi), final short ि ु said,
# ड़ ढ़ = ɽ ɽʰ, Hindi-type schwa deletion otherwise; ɦ is written h.
# Magahi sentence gold set, written 2026-11-14 before any Magahi-specific rules. Sentences 1-108 and 133-152:
# written for this set on the patterns of the grammars named in words.src (colloquial copula हे/हइ/हथ, 1st person
# -इयो, 2nd person -ऽ), vocabulary from Wiktionary and FLORES-200 mag_Deva; sentences 109-132: FLORES-200 mag_Deva
# dev/devtest (CC BY-SA 4.0, evaluation only; in 132 the digits of 16वीं are written out). Pronunciation hand-written with the
# conventions of words.src. Format: sentence <TAB> pronunciation.
# Columns: id, kind, text, expected, category, source (with licence), split, date written.
